thesis: This episode argues that incumbent technology giants like Microsoft and Meta are well-positioned to win in the AI wave due to their strong distribution and access to technology via APIs. Conversely, Google faces a mixed outlook; while it has distribution advantages, its strict brand constraint against hallucinations in search limits its ability to be a frontier player, creating an opening for startups like Perplexity.
